name: Eric Yeh
lead: I build small, sharp tools for my own life — then ship them so other people can use them too.
bio: I started out writing C# control software for pharmaceutical packaging machines, moved through .NET back ends, and these days mostly write TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers. Outside of work I keep turning everyday annoyances into apps: an investment tracker that lives in Notion, an offline travel companion, and an end-to-end encrypted link relay.
